explication: {gsm} is an R package for clinical-trial risk-based quality monitoring: it runs site-level assessments, flags potential issues, visualizes results, and produces reports. The README describes the core workflow as raw-data input, transformation, analysis, thresholding, flagging, and summarization; it also documents workflow execution and site/country reporting. The graph follows those documented stages and preserves visualization and reporting as distinct capabilities. Source excerpts are concentrated in browser widgets, so internal R calls and report-generation wiring are not asserted beyond documented relationships.
